issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print both 'GAAP Basis' and 'Budgetary Basis' actual columns
issues.issue: Extractor chose the budgetary-basis actuals (the column compared with budget). This is defensible, but the GAAP-basis column is the one that ties to the p2 statement (e.g. General Fund Maintenance 45,660 GAAP vs 61,366 budgetary). Assumption; noted in notes.
SID registered warrants are interest-bearing short-term borrowing; 'debt - due within one year' may fit better. Judgment call.
